title: Certify store identities over numeral expressions of one value
summary: The Lean reconstructor now matches array store identities whose indices or values are numeral expressions of one value, such as (* 1 2) and 2, and proves each value in Lean with grind before simp applies the identity. Rewrite steps that Z3's array rewriter evaluates this way now pass the Lean check, with no new axiom or trusted hint.
